sections.content: Use ir a + infinitive to describe personal plans and goals. Combine it with familiar vocabulary for memories, learning and travel: *Voy* a *aprender* *español*. *Vamos* a *viajar*. The structure is useful for saying what you intend to do next.

items.english: I am going to learn Spanish.

items.spanish: Voy a viajar el próximo año.
items.english: I am going to travel next year.
We are going to write our plans.

items.spanish: Carlos va a seguir estudiando español.
items.english: Carlos is going to continue studying Spanish.

sections.content: In ir a + infinitive, only ir is conjugated: *voy* a *escribir*, vas a escribir, *vamos* a escribir. Do not conjugate the second verb.
